note: The simulator's constants (tools/rl/sim_env.py), set from the real environment's v1 logs: tools/rl/calibrate.py over the stdout.txt of rl/policy's real1 run (build/rl/servers/env-26100, env-26101: 559 episodes, 318 of a crew of one, 35.1 thousand skill results). fail_fresh: a failure of an attempt not right after the same skill failed (a new target); sticky: the share of retries of a failed skill that fail again while the agent has not moved (real: 0.93-0.99). dur_*: game seconds, from a ridge fit of the episodes' game seconds over their skills (r2 0.73) where it is sane, rounded; the fit is degenerate for the cheap and collinear skills (look_around, wait, equip, go_to come out 0; place 34 s takes the walks beside it; craft 11 s is a 2x2 and a 3x3 together): those are judgment, see docs/rl/POLICY-v2.md. Skills v1 had no logs of (v2's new ones) take `default` or a guess named in the simulator.
growth_note: vanilla 1.7.10 times; the environment grows the crew's crops, saplings and young constants.grow (20) times faster (CONTRACT-v2.md 8), the simulator divides by it; the breeding pause is not sped up

waves.note: the waves' fight against the game's engine (tools/rl/calibrate_waves.py, docs/rl/ENGINE.md section 9), with the game's rules in the simulator (an agent back at the base a second after its death with an empty bag; a run lost at 6 deaths in a wave): 12 engine episodes of waves:normal, crew 2, v31eng1; a game second, engine / simulator fitted (before): kills 0.048 / 0.069 (0.090), breaches 0.045 / 0.044 (0.010), damage 0.53 / 0.69 (0.14), deaths 0.017 / 0.014 (0), mob-seconds 1.05 / 0.76 (0.06). gate_leak: the gate's opening, open while no door shuts it, lets a wave in as a hole of that share would; kill, hurt: multipliers of the wave's kills and hits

live_v3.note: contract 3's live scripted runs (rl/v2-env 0e1d5e8, tools/rl/rl_smoke.py, build/rl/servers/env-26110,26111 of aiguide-rl-v2-env: 17 episodes, one a scenario, 900 skill results; a script's choices, not a policy's). Failure share and fresh failure (n): ascend 1.0 (28, all NO_PATH), build_gate 0.97 (32, OUT_OF_REACH), place_at 0.69 / 0.62 (51, BLOCKED), retreat 0.86 (28, NO_PATH), take_post 0.76 / 0.2 (17), go_to 0.23 (133), build_wall 0.81 / 0.36 (37), chop_tree 0.44 / 0.22 (32), craft 0.17 / 0.03 (81), hold_line 0.25 (83), lure 0.6 (5), tunnel 0.75 (4). Taken into skills above with judgment (the samples are small and one agent repeats a failure): place_at, build_gate, ascend, tunnel, lure; the rest as v1. Goals reached: wood, pickaxe, sword, armor, bow, mine_trip, farm, pasture, enchant, achievements; not: iron, diamond, food, fortify (crew 1), the waves.

dig.note: the digging zombies in the simulators (docs/rl/ZOMBIES-DIG.md, tools/rl/zdig.py --write): depth_blocks are the levels 1 and 2 under the surface; reach_s the seconds a digger of a tier needs to get from the surface to an agent there (the planner of ZombieDig.java over soil 5 and stone, from 10 blocks off; null: never), by the engine's rules of breaking; the hearing, the tiers and the numbers are rl/zombie-dig.json's
